stories.headline: Anthropic pushes ahead with IPO despite tech selloff — valuation cut to $1–1.3T
stories.summary: Anthropic is moving forward with its pre-Thanksgiving IPO even as the selloff pressures valuations down from a $2T target.

stories.headline: OpenAI raises $11B at a $1.25T valuation — and may raise $20B total
stories.summary: OpenAI closed an $11B round at $1.25T and plans to raise as much as $20B in total, seeking smaller investors to reach the goal.

stories.headline: Nov 15 is officially a dark day for Game Pass — 13 games leave, including GoldenEye 007
stories.summary: Thirteen games leave Xbox Game Pass at once on Nov 15; Football Manager 26 leaves earlier, on Nov 10, the day its sequel launches.

stories.headline: 10+ Game Pass titles confirmed for Xbox's 25th anniversary week
stories.summary: Eight games join Game Pass Essential on Nov 15 itself — Banjo-Kazooie, Gears of War: Judgment, Halo: Spartan Assault and more — with six more across the week.

stories.headline: Gunman kills six in Kraków's main square; three more bodies found at his home
stories.summary: A 25-year-old opened fire in Kraków's market square Saturday afternoon; at least six killed, 16 wounded, a Briton among the dead.

stories.headline: Russia fires 36 ballistic missiles at Kyiv region as Abu Dhabi talks near
stories.summary: Overnight Nov 6–7 barrage plus 172 drones across 13 regions; air defences downed only 4 of the missiles, Zelenskyy said.

stories.headline: Stranger Things confirms live-action prequel 'Other Worlds' — 1955, Marion, Nevada, 2028
stories.summary: The teaser confirms the setting (Marion, Nevada, April 19, 1955) and a 2028 release; Kate Trefry showruns, Joe Wright directs the first three episodes.
